title: Per-token timing histograms and region spillover tracing
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a baseline instrumentation and dashboard set for per-token timing histograms and cross-region spillover tracing to support SLO-driven admission control and circuit breaker tuning. Current dashboards show request-level P95/P99 which obscures where latency accrues inside long responses and how regional failovers amplify per-token tail. This ticket adds: 1) continuous per-token latency histograms (aggregated by model, route, region, and admission decision), 2) KV-cache hit/miss correlation panels by token position, 3) a traceable spillover id injected into requests to follow a single user request across region failovers and model variant fallbacks, and 4) derived health signals used by the adaptive load-shedding controller. This work will inform new SLO thresholds and automated shedding profiles for Dedicated/Dedicated-VPC customers.
acceptance_criteria: Per-token latency histogram metric emitted for all generation routes with labels: model, route, region, token_index, admission_decision
Dashboard panels in Console showing per-token p50/p90/p99 heatmaps and token_position trend lines
Spillover tracing header (X-RW-Spillover-ID) present in failover paths and visible in traces for at least 7 days
KV-cache hit/miss correlated to token latency and exposed as joinable metrics in dashboards
Derived SLI signals available for SLO computation: token_p99_by_route, token_tail_error_rate, regional_spillover_rate
End-to-end test included that simulates multi-region failover and validates metric continuity and spillover id propagation
tasks: Spec metric names and label schema in Ingest Design doc: /docs/observability/per-token-metrics.md
Add instrumentation to runtime path that records per-token durations and emits histograms (feature-flag guarded)
Implement spillover id propagation in proxy and backend; ensure id survives retries and fallback flows
Update KV cache instrumentation to emit token_index-labeled hits/misses
Build Console dashboard with heatmap, histogram, and trace link panels
Create synthetic load harness that exercises long-form generations and triggers regional failover
Rollout behind flag to 10% of traffic, monitor impact, adjust cardinality if ingestion cost high
Promote to 100% and add SLO definitions based on observed distributions
notes: Design decision: use Exponential Histogram buckets to keep cardinality controllable while preserving tail fidelity
Trade-off: emitting token_index for very long sequences increases label cardinality; cap token_index labeling to first 512 tokens and use 'overflow' bucket for >512
Privacy: spillover id is opaque random UUID, does not contain PII; traces restricted to internal retention
Cost mitigation: downsample low-risk routes and emit full histograms only for routes marked 'long-gen' in route config
Coordination: Need to sync with billing to account for metric ingestion increase before wide rollout
dashboards: KV-Cache Hit vs Token Latency Correlation
